lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Thank you for calling customer support, this is Alex speaking. How can I help you?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: I forgot my password and the reset email never arrives. I have tried five times and I am locked out of my account.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: I am sorry about that, being locked out is annoying. Let me help you recover your password.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Please do, I need to access my account today and this is getting ridiculous.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: I can see the reset emails were going to an old address. I have updated it and sent a new reset link just now.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Okay, I got it. I have set a new password and I am logged in. Thank you so much.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Wonderful. Is there anything else I can help with?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: No, that is all, thanks for your help.
